MINI MINUTES: This cause came as Reassigment from the PJ Department.
Judge: Ollie Marie Victoire, CSR: Ann Mendoza, Bailiff: Louise Perotti, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo
John R. Weinstein for Plaintiff: Ahmed Nasser
Fausto Sousa, Defendant present in pro per.
Stipulation for entry of judgment read on the record as follows:
Plaintiff is entitled to a future judgment against the defendant for restitution and possession of the premises of the property located at: 2244 - 23rd St. SF
Forfeiture of the rental agreement.
Security deposit is forfeited.
Defendant shall pay by certified check or money order to Plaintiff attorney the sum of $1,500.00 by 5:00 pm on July 28, 2003.
Defendant to vacate the premises on or before August 31, 2003. If defendant vacates as agreed, Plaintiff to dismiss with prejudice.
Each party waives claim against the other.
Each to bears its own costs and attorney's fees.
Defendant to leave the premises in "broom-clean" condition.
No one else occupying the premises who claims a right to possession.
If defendant did not comply with the agreement, plaintiff may so state by ex parte declaration, with 48 hours notice to the defendant and have judgment entered for possession and back rent in the amount of $3,600.00 less credit and attorney fees of $750.00
Defendant waives any right to make a motion to set aside or vacate the judgment, or to move for a new trial and to appeal on any groud from any judgment entered herein.
